doc.icon: icon for this FAB, typically an [Icon]
doc.onClick: called when this FAB is clicked
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this FAB
doc.expanded: controls the expansion state of this FAB. In an expanded state, the FAB will show both the [icon] and [text]. In a collapsed state, the FAB will show only the [icon].
doc.shape: defines the shape of this FAB's container and shadow (when using [elevation])
doc.containerColor: the color used for the background of this FAB. Use [Color.Transparent] to have no color.
doc.contentColor: the preferred color for content inside this FAB. Defaults to either the matching content color for [containerColor], or to the current [LocalContentColor] if [containerColor] is not a color from the theme.
doc.elevation: [FloatingActionButtonElevation] used to resolve the elevation for this FAB in different states. This controls the size of the shadow below the FAB. Additionally, when the container color is [ColorScheme.surface], this controls the amount of primary color applied as an overlay. See also: [Surface].
doc.elevation.defaultElevation: the elevation used when the [FloatingActionButton] has no other [Interaction]s.
doc.elevation.pressedElevation: the elevation used when the [FloatingActionButton] is pressed.
doc.elevation.focusedElevation: the elevation used when the [FloatingActionButton] is focused.
doc.elevation.hoveredElevation: the elevation used when the [FloatingActionButton] is hovered.
doc.interactionSource: an optional hoisted [MutableInteractionSource] for observing and emitting [Interaction]s for this FAB. You can use this to change the FAB's appearance or preview the FAB in different states. Note that if `null` is provided, interactions will still happen internally.
